checks.explanation: The premise never materialized: RFK Jr. suspended his campaign and endorsed Trump in August 2024, ultimately receiving only about 0.4% of the popular vote (roughly 594,000 votes), nowhere close to the 19%+ threshold the prediction was conditioned on. His actual measured impact was modest (an estimated roughly 0.2-1 point net swing toward Trump in some analyses), far short of the scenario predicted.

sources.title: How much of the vote did RFK Jr. get?

checks.explanation: Directionally correct but the magnitude is hard to confirm precisely. A real wave of VC firm shutdowns and restructuring did follow the weak 2021 vintage, including notable names like Foundry Group ($3.5B AUM) and OpenView shutting down, and LP commitments to venture fell over 60% in 2023-2024 versus the prior two years, with capital consolidating into just a handful of firms. However, no source confirms the specific 'as many as 50% of firms' figure.

sources.title: Venture Capital Partners Are Leaving Big Firms in Droves
